prompt:
Flat vector illustration, square, top-down flat lay (knolling) of camping gear on a fully transparent background. Match the drawing style of the reference image exactly: flat fills, faceted hard-edged geometry, no outlines, no gradients, no shading, no texture, no shadows, no ground plane.
Center: a small pitched A-frame tent seen from directly above, a pale mint canvas with a deep green ridge line and four guy lines to square stakes.
Laid out in a neat grid around the tent, all seen from above, evenly spaced with clear gaps, six pieces of gear and nothing else: a folded paper trail map with contour lines and a small brass compass on it; a closed laptop in charcoal; a camping lantern in deep green with a pale glass panel; a neatly coiled climbing rope in moss green; a small field notebook with a pencil; a rolled-up canvas tool roll with a wrench and a screwdriver tucked in it.
Palette limited to deep green #006636, moss #417703, pale mint #dff3e4, stone #eceee9, charcoal #3d3f44 and white. No text, no labels, no people, no background, no frame. Genuine transparent alpha around every object.
